title: Select Water Solutions Announces Closing of Pilot Water Solutions Acquisition
summary: GAINESVILLE, Texas, Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Select Water Solutions, Inc. (NYSE: WTTR) ("Select," the "Company," "we" or "us") announced…...
body_markdown:
GAINESVILLE, Texas


, Nov. 2, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Select Water Solutions, Inc. (NYSE: WTTR) ("Select," the "Company," "we" or "us") announced today that it has closed the previously announced acquisition of Pilot Water Solutions LLC ("Pilot Water"), a leading, private water midstream company with primary operations in the Delaware Basin.


John Schmitz, Chairman of the Board, President and CEO, stated, "We are excited to announce the completion of our acquisition of Pilot Water Solutions and to welcome the Pilot Water employees to the Select family. The addition of Pilot Water enhances our position as one of the leading water midstream providers in the Delaware Basin, and further strengthens Select's unique ability to manage the industry's growing produced water volumes with comprehensive solutions. Pilot Water's sizable contractual revenue, minimum volume commitments, and its significant operational and undeveloped capacity, complements Select's extensive acreage dedications and enables future growth and produced water volume capture. We look forward to integrating our industry leading recycling business and pro forma scaled disposal platform in the Delaware Basin to more efficiently address the basin's full life-cycle water needs and to unlock value and cost savings for our customers."


Under the terms of the transaction, a subsidiary of Select acquired Pilot Water on a debt-free basis for aggregate consideration of approximately $700 million, including approximately $600 million of cash paid at closing (subject to customary post-closing adjustments) and 5,149,331 shares of Class A common stock of Select. Additionally, one of the sellers has a right to an additional $15 million contingent payment, payable upon the satisfaction of certain operational milestones expected in early 2027. The purchase agreement also provides that such seller will receive a true-up payment, payable in cash, if the 30-day volume-weighted average price of Select's Class A common stock as of the trading day immediately prior to the six-month anniversary of the closing date is lower than the 30-day volume-weighted average price immediately prior to the closing date.


In connection with the closing of the Pilot Water acquisition, Select's new credit agreement, which provides for a $500 million revolving credit facility, became effective, and Select's previous sustainability-linked senior secured credit facility was terminated.


**About Select Water Solutions, Inc.**


Select is a leading provider of sustainable water and chemical solutions to the energy industry. These solutions are supported by the Company's critical water infrastructure assets, chemical manufacturing and water treatment and recycling capabilities. As a leader in sustainable water and chemical solutions, Select places the utmost importance on safe, environmentally responsible management of water throughout the lifecycle of a well. Additionally, Select believes that responsibly managing water resources throughout its operations to help conserve and protect the environment is paramount to the Company's continued success. For more information, please visit Select's website,[https://www.selectwater.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812409-1&h=1438422216&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.selectwater.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.selectwater.com) .
